answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 12643 Country: India Title: as salaam muftisaheb please give me dua or zikhar to become famous and belovedd in family;reliates and friends and protect from enymies Question: as salaam muftisaheb please give me dua or zikhar to become famous and belovedd in family;reliates and friends and protect from enymies Answer ID: 12643 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 731/547=L/1430) Proceed to do good deeds and try to follow the sunnah. In-sha-Allah, you will be loved by family members, relatives and friends. In order to protect yourself from enemies, recite the below mentioned verse 11 times after every salah: ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنۃ للقوم الضالین ونجنا برحمتک من القوم الکافرین Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
